desc: This is the first ballot of the Common Cancer Data Model FHIR IG STU 1
introduction: The HL7 Europe Cancer Common Data Model (ECCDM) initiative aims to define a European common data model for cancer: a minimal, shared, and extensible set of concepts and relationships capable of representing cancer-related information across different contexts and use cases.
